prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE reusable empty ornamental card frame for the Fool pathway, portrait 2:3, NOT a finished character card. TRUE GOD tier — an awe-inspiring divine law architecture, not merely a more expensive human frame. Monumental perfectly poised concentric oval halos nested inside a grand tall rectangular outer sanctum; pale gold, luminous ivory-silver and deep violet crystal. Immense layered sculptural columns and mathematically ordered rays, impossible suspended connections, restrained celestial radiance emanating from actual engraved surfaces. Regal, sacred, serene and overwhelming. Magnificent openwork with major clean negative spaces and sovereign scale. As lavish as a supreme altar yet visually ordered, NOT a thin ellipse, NOT a crown or wings, NOT a cluttered fantasy border. Shared family: theatrical curtain-fold geometry and mysterious antique craft. FRONT ORTHOGRAPHIC VIEW, complete rectangular outside edge with a small transparent margin, no tilt. Outer frame fills roughly 94% of the canvas. Reserve the central opening from about x18% to82%, y24% to82% as fully TRANSPARENT for a separately composited illustration. Reserve an empty open socket at top center for a separate emblem and a broad unlettered nameplate at bottom. ALL areas outside the frame and inside the central opening must be GENUINELY TRANSPARENT; all piercings transparent. Frame only; NO character, NO scene, NO sky or fog painted inside the hole, NO letters, NO numbers, NO readable or fake writing, NO watermark, no checkerboard pixels. Surface lighting from upper left, exquisitely rendered relief.
